title: China to Belgium Heat Pump Standards — Cross-Standard Comparison
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: CE Marking Mandatory for Belgian Market
rows.target_requirement: CE marking is mandatory for heat pumps placed on the Belgian market as Belgium is an EU member state. Applicable directives: LVD 2014/35/EU, EMC Directive 2014/30/EU, PED 2014/68/EU, Ecodesign Regulation (EU) 2016/2281. Market surveillance authority: FPS Economy (Direction générale de la Qualité et de la Sécurité). Declaration of Conformity (DoC) must be available in Dutch (NL) and/or French (FR).
rows.china_equivalent: China Compulsory Certification (CCC/3C) under CNCA is required for heat pump products sold in China. Administered by CNCA; testing at CNAS-accredited labs. Not mutually recognized with CE.
rows.gap: CCC and CE are separate certification systems with no mutual recognition agreement. Full CE conformity assessment including applicable harmonized standards and EU notified bodies required for Belgium.
rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] CE marking is a legal prerequisite for selling heat pumps in Belgium. CCC certificates do not substitute. A complete technical file and Declaration of Conformity in Dutch/French must be maintained.

rows.target_requirement: NBN (Bureau voor Normalisatie / Bureau de Normalisation) publishes Belgian national standards, which are transpositions of EN/ISO standards. Belgium requires product documentation (user manuals, installation guides, Declaration of Conformity) in Dutch (NL) and/or French (FR) per Royal Decree. NBN also manages Belgian participation in CEN/CENELEC standardization.
target_standards: Belgian Royal Decree on language requirements for product documentation
NBN EN standards (transposed EN harmonized standards)
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese product documentation must be in Simplified Chinese (Mandarin) under GB standards and CCC requirements. Translation into Dutch/French for EU export is an additional requirement not covered by Chinese domestic rules.
china_standards: GB/T 9969 (industrial product instructions — Chinese language requirement)
rows.gap: All product documentation for Belgian market must be in Dutch and/or French. Chinese-language manuals are insufficient. NBN standards (transposed EN) apply; Chinese GB standards are reference only.
rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Belgian market requires Dutch and/or French product documentation. NBN-published transposed EN standards are the applicable reference. Chinese GB standards serve as internal baseline only.

source.publisher: NBN (Bureau voor Normalisatie / Bureau de Normalisation)

rows.target_requirement: Commission Regulation (EU) 2016/2281 (implementing Ecodesign Directive 2009/125/EC) sets minimum seasonal energy performance requirements for heat pumps in Belgium. FPS Economy enforces, with regional energy regulators (VREG in Flanders, CWaPE in Wallonia, BRUGEL in Brussels-Capital Region) for energy labelling. Minimum seasonal space heating energy efficiency (ηs) thresholds apply.
rows.china_equivalent: China uses GB 21455-2019 (room air conditioner energy efficiency — IPLV/HSPF) and GB 19576-2019 (unitary air conditioners energy efficiency) as analogues. Energy Star equivalent is 能效标识 (China Energy Label).
rows.gap: EU Ecodesign ηs thresholds at EU climate reference conditions (average/warmer/colder) differ from Chinese GB IPLV test conditions. Products meeting Chinese energy efficiency ratings may not meet EU ηs minima without re-testing.
rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] (EU) 2016/2281 Ecodesign is mandatory in Belgium. Heat pumps must meet minimum ηs values and bear CE marking. Chinese GB energy efficiency certifications are not substitutable; re-testing to EN 14825 required.

rows.requirement: EU Energy Labelling for Heat Pumps
rows.target_requirement: Regulation (EU) 2017/1369 (Energy Labelling Framework) plus delegated regulation (EU) 2016/2281 require heat pumps sold in Belgium to display EU energy label (A+++ to D scale for space heating). FPS Economy enforces. Label must be in Dutch (NL) and/or French (FR) for Belgian market. Digital label (QR code linking to EPREL database) required from 2021.
target_standards: EPREL (European Product Registry for Energy Labelling)
rows.china_equivalent: China Energy Label (能效标识) under GB/T 31349 and product-specific standards uses 1–5 star scale. Registration with SAMR required. Not equivalent to EU label.
china_standards: 能效标识管理办法 (China Energy Label Regulation)
rows.gap: EU energy label and EPREL registration are mandatory for Belgian market. Chinese energy label is not recognized. Documentation in Dutch/French required. Different seasonal efficiency calculation methods.
rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] EU energy label and EPREL product registration are mandatory in Belgium. Product documentation in Dutch and/or French is required. Chinese 能效标识 is not equivalent and cannot substitute.

rows.target_requirement: Belgium implements the EU EMC Directive 2014/30/EU via Royal Decree. FPS Economy (Direction générale de la Qualité et de la Sécurité) is the market surveillance authority. Harmonized standards EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, EN 55014-1, EN 55014-2 apply. Belgian notified bodies include ISSEP and Vinçotte (now Bureau Veritas).
target_standards: Royal Decree implementing EMC Directive in Belgium
rows.china_equivalent: China requires GB/T 17626 series (IEC 61000-equivalent) EMC tests and CCC certification under CNCA-C08 scheme. Testing must be done at CNAS-accredited labs.
rows.gap: CE marking and EU notified-body test reports are required; CCC certificates are not accepted in Belgium. Belgian documentation must be in Dutch (NL) or French (FR). Market surveillance by FPS Economy.
rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Chinese EMC certificates (CCC) are not recognized in Belgium. Manufacturers must obtain CE marking under 2014/30/EU with harmonized EN standards tested at EU-recognized labs.

rows.requirement: Low Voltage Directive & RGIE/AREI Electrical Safety
rows.target_requirement: LVD 2014/35/EU applies to heat pumps. Belgium additionally requires compliance with RGIE/AREI (Algemeen Reglement op de Elektrische Installaties / Règlement Général sur les Installations Électriques) for electrical installation. Grid: 230/400V 50Hz TN-S. Enforced by FPS Economy and accredited inspection bodies.
rows.china_equivalent: GB 4706.1 (household appliances general safety) and GB 14711 (motors for household appliances) cover LVD-equivalent requirements in China. CCC certification required.
rows.gap: Belgium requires CE under LVD plus conformity to RGIE/AREI for installation. Documentation in Dutch/French required. Chinese CCC does not substitute for CE marking.
rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Both CE marking under LVD 2014/35/EU and installation compliance with RGIE/AREI are mandatory in Belgium. Separate certification paths from China's CCC scheme.

rows.target_requirement: PED 2014/68/EU mandatory in Belgium, enforced by FPS Employment Labour and Social Dialogue (Service public fédéral Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale). Belgian notified body AIB-Vinçotte International (NB 0197) performs conformity assessment. EN 378:2016+A1:2020 is the harmonized standard covering refrigerating systems safety.
rows.china_equivalent: China uses GB 150 (pressure vessels), TSG 21 (fixed pressure vessel safety technology supervision regulations) and TSG 07 (pressure equipment manufacturing licensing) for refrigerant pressure components. Special Equipment Supervision by SAMR.
rows.gap: PED requires CE marking with EU notified body involvement for Category II+ equipment. Chinese GB/TSG certificates are not accepted. Belgian enforcement via FPS Employment.
rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] PED 2014/68/EU is mandatory for heat pump refrigerant circuits in Belgium. CE marking with AIB-Vinçotte or equivalent EU notified body required. Chinese TSG/GB certificates not substitutable.

source.publisher: FPS Employment Labour and Social Dialogue Belgium

rows.target_requirement: EN 378:2016+A1:2020 (4-part series) is the key harmonized standard for refrigerating systems in Belgium, covering safety and environmental requirements including pressure limits, refrigerant charge limits, leak detection, and machinery room requirements. Mandatory under PED and F-gas frameworks.
rows.china_equivalent: GB/T 18837-2015 (multi-split heat pump systems) and GB/T 9098 (refrigerating appliances) partially overlap with EN 378 scope. GB 9237 covers refrigerating systems safety for industrial applications.
rows.gap: EN 378 is more comprehensive than Chinese equivalents regarding leak detection, refrigerant concentration limits, and machinery room design. Full EN 378 compliance required for CE marking.
rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] EN 378 compliance is required for CE marking in Belgium. Chinese GB standards are broadly aligned but EN 378 imposes stricter leak detection and ventilation requirements.

source.publisher: NBN (Bureau voor Normalisatie / Bureau de Normalisation)

rows.requirement: EU F-Gas Regulation & Belgian Regional F-Gas Enforcement
rows.target_requirement: EU F-gas Regulation (EU) 2024/573 (recast) applies in Belgium with regional enforcement: Flanders — OVAM / Departement Omgeving; Wallonia — SPW Agriculture, Ressources naturelles et Environnement; Brussels — Bruxelles Environnement / Leefmilieu Brussel. R-410A (GWP 2088) restricted; lower-GWP refrigerants (R-32, R-454B) required from 2025 for new units. Technician certification mandatory per region.
target_standards: Belgian Regional F-gas enforcement decrees (Flanders, Wallonia, Brussels-Capital Region)
rows.china_equivalent: China follows GB/T 7778 refrigerant designation standard and national HFC phase-down schedule under Kigali Amendment (ratified 2021). No direct regional enforcement analog; national MEE oversees ODS/F-gas.
rows.gap: Belgium enforces stricter EU 2024/573 HFC phase-down with R-410A restrictions from 2025. Technician certification required in each region. Chinese R-410A units will face compliance barriers post-2025.
rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Heat pumps using R-410A will face sales restrictions in Belgium under (EU) 2024/573. Export products must use low-GWP refrigerants (R-32, R-454B or natural refrigerants). Belgian regional certification for technicians is separate from product certification.

rows.target_requirement: Technicians handling fluorinated refrigerants in Belgium must hold regional certification (attestation de technicien en fluides frigorigènes / certificaat van koelmiddelentechnicus). FANC (Federaal Agentschap voor Nucleaire Controle) provides federal coordination on F-gas policy, while enforcement is regional. Companies must also be F-gas certified. URL for Brussels: https://environnement.brussels/thematiques/energie-et-climat/protection-du-climat/les-gaz-fluores
rows.china_equivalent: China requires 特种设备作业人员证 (Special Equipment Operator Certificate) for refrigeration technicians, issued by local SAMR bureaus. Scope and GWP thresholds differ from EU requirements.
china_standards: 特种设备作业人员证 (refrigeration category)
rows.gap: Belgian certification is regional (Flanders/Wallonia/Brussels) and EU-framework-based with stricter GWP thresholds. Chinese operator certificates are not recognized. Installation contractors must obtain Belgian regional F-gas company certification.
rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Belgian installation contractors must hold regional F-gas technician certification. This is separate from product CE marking. Chinese SAMR special equipment operator certificates are not recognized in Belgium.

source.publisher: FANC (Federaal Agentschap voor Nucleaire Controle / Agence Fédérale de Contrôle Nucléaire)

rows.requirement: EN 14511 Heat Pump Safety & Performance Standard
rows.target_requirement: EN 14511:2023 (Air conditioners, liquid chilling packages and heat pumps using electrically driven compressors for space heating/cooling) is the key harmonized safety and performance standard for heat pumps in Belgium, mandatory under LVD and Ecodesign frameworks. FPS Economy is the market surveillance authority. Testing at EU accredited labs required.
rows.china_equivalent: GB/T 18430.1-2007 (vapor-compression liquid chilling packages) and GB/T 18430.2-2008 (heat pump liquid chilling packages) are Chinese equivalents. GB/T 7725-2004 covers room air conditioner-type heat pumps.
rows.gap: EN 14511:2023 test conditions (EN 14825 climate reference points) differ from Chinese GB test conditions. EU accredited lab testing required; Chinese lab results alone are insufficient for CE marking.
rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] EN 14511:2023 compliance is required for CE marking in Belgium. Chinese GB/T 18430 tests are not directly substitutable due to differing test conditions and climate reference points.

rows.target_requirement: The RGIE (Règlement Général sur les Installations Électriques) / AREI (Algemeen Reglement op de Elektrische Installaties) is Belgium's mandatory electrical installation safety code. All heat pump electrical installations must comply with RGIE/AREI. Inspection by accredited bodies (Vinçotte/Bureau Veritas, AIB, SOCOTEC Belgium, DEKRA) required before commissioning. Belgian grid: 230V single-phase / 400V three-phase, 50Hz.
rows.china_equivalent: China uses GB 50054-2011 (Low Voltage Electrical Installation Design Code) and GB 16895 series (IEC 60364 equivalent) for electrical installation safety. Inspection by local quality supervision authorities.
rows.gap: RGIE/AREI inspection by Belgian accredited bodies is mandatory before heat pump commissioning. Chinese GB 50054 compliance does not substitute. Belgian grid (400V/50Hz TN-S) must be verified for compatibility.
rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] RGIE/AREI compliance and third-party inspection are mandatory for heat pump installations in Belgium. Chinese GB electrical standards do not substitute for RGIE/AREI. Accredited Belgian inspection bodies must verify compliance.
